digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and GET rotation state
propositions: Introduce a new sidecar file (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json) to persist GET rotation state while dual-writing the legacy inline field during rollout to ensure interleaved old/new binary compatibility.
Read the maximum of sidecar and legacy inline values for each Jira key, and write every new rotation stamp to both representations through BindingStore.save() paths.

The rotation module must fail open, load legacy-only state into memory, and persist the sidecar only when BindingStore.save() is called (end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement paths), while reconcile-check with persist=False must not create the sidecar.
Both rotation files must be staged and committed together in explicit binding-store commits without git add -A, and must remain under the 800-line module size constraint in outbound_differ.py.

A reverted old-binary reader must ignore the sidecar but see the legacy field advanced by every new-binary pass, and an all-new-binary sequence must produce identical rotation order as an interleaved old/new sequence.
